from sympy.stats import SkewNormal, cdf
x = owens_t(1, 2)
for prec in (53, 100, 200):
    value = x._eval_evalf(prec)
    print('hook', prec, type(value).__name__, value)
    assert isinstance(value, Float)
e = erf(-3*sqrt(2))/2 + S.Half - 2*owens_t(6, 2)
reference = e.evalf(80)
print('default:', e.evalf())
print('reference:', reference)
assert abs(e.evalf()/reference - 1) < S('1e-14')
tail = cdf(SkewNormal('x', 0, 1, 2))(-6).evalf()

assert abs(tail/reference - 1) < S('1e-14')

for expr in (owens_t(h, 2), owens_t(1, a), owens_t(h, a), owens_t(I, S.Half)):
    print('other:', expr.evalf())
